title: picris hispanica
intro: Picris hispanica, commonly known as Spanish oxeye or Picris, is a plant species in the dandelion family. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in various forms for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Picris hispanica include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in treating conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
